summary: ESCO Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a New Credit Agreement to finance its previously announced acquisition of Megger Group Limited for ~$2.35 billion. The deal consideration consists of $922M cash plus 5.10M ESCO shares, subject to post-closing adjustments. The New Credit Agreement provides a $500M secured revolving credit facility and a $500M secured term loan A, with JPMorgan as administrative agent. The agreement becomes effective upon and concurrently with the acquisition closing, replacing the existing credit facility. The transaction is expected to close pending conditions. Watch for regulatory clearances and financing conditions.
